description: This Java class `ManifestProvider` provides a way to obtain a manifest string from an object, either by calling its `getManifest()` method if it implements `WithManifest`, or falling back to the object's class simple name. It's designed as an immutable singleton and implements the `Function<Object, String>` interface.

classes.name: ManifestProvider
classes.description: A singleton class implementing Function<Object, String>, providing manifest strings for objects based on whether they implement WithManifest or not.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ManifestProvider.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Returns the manifest string for the given object, calling getManifest() if the object implements WithManifest, otherwise returns the class's simple name.
